publisher: Comune di Bologna, measurements from ARPAE Emilia-Romagna

notes.before: Hourly means at the three Bologna stations, 1 January–16 September 2024. Coordinates come from the 2019 regional station list, UTM zone 32N. The street colour is a kerb exhaust proxy from the traffic model. It is not a plume and not a concentration forecast.
notes.after: Hourly means at the three Bologna stations, 1 January–16 September 2026. The tram is not in passenger service in 2026, so these readings do not include it. Coordinates come from the 2019 regional station list, UTM zone 32N. The street colour is a kerb exhaust proxy from the traffic model. It is not a plume and not a concentration forecast.
notes.compare: Hourly means at the three Bologna stations, 1 January–16 September of 2024 and of 2026, so the seasons match. The street colour is a kerb exhaust proxy from the traffic model. It is not a plume and not a concentration forecast.
